## My visualization

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

storms |>
  ggplot() +
  geom_point(mapping = aes(x = pressure, y = wind))

```


## Big Question

Count the number of observations each year for hurricanes with windspeeds above the 75th percentile for hurricanes in that year. 


```{r}
storms |>
  filter(status == "hurricane") |>
  group_by(year) |> 
  mutate(threshold = quantile(wind, probs = 0.75)) |>
  ungroup() |>
  filter(wind > threshold) |>
  count(year) |>
  print(n = Inf)
```
